notes:
Primary source: TSL Products' own PAM2-MK2 product page (https://tslproducts.com/product/pam2-mk2/), fetched directly and repeatedly — confirms port QUANTITIES/features reliably: 2x auto-sensing 1080p HD/SDI inputs, re-clocked HD/SDI + downconverted SDI/composite outputs, 2 analogue stereo inputs, 4-pair/8ch AES in and out (110Ω balanced or 75Ω unbalanced via optional CAB-D25-BNC cable), dual 12V DC inputs, 1x USB, 1x SD card slot (SD slot omitted from ports — no matching connector id in the allowed list), serial remote control, headphone output, and GPI-triggerable presets.

Could NOT reach a full rear-panel pinout diagram/datasheet: the linked live-production.tv datasheet PDF, and third-party manual hosts (Yumpu, Manualzz, B&H, Full Compass), all returned HTTP 403 or bot-verification walls under normal verified-TLS fetches — none were bypassed. Connector SHAPES for the analogue/AES/GPI/remote ports above are therefore inferred, partly cross-referenced against a secondary "PAM2 MK2 and PAM2-3G16 Combined Handbook" (which covers two related-but-different TSL products, so its D25/D15/D9 connector details may not map 1:1 onto the MK2 specifically).

Other caveats:
- The manufacturer page itself is internally inconsistent about form factor: the overview text calls it a "2U Precision Audio Monitor" while the specifications list says "Compact, lightweight 1U case, 250mm deep." Reported rackUnits=1 based on the explicit spec line, but this contradiction is unresolved.
- SDI grade (3G) is inferred from the stated 1080p50/59.94/60 formats, which exceed 1.5G HD-SDI bandwidth; marketing copy only ever says "HD/SDI."
- No AC mains/IEC inlet is listed for the MK2 (power is stated as dual 12V DC only) — an "IEC mains inlet" mentioned in the combined handbook is believed to belong to the companion PAM2-3G16 product, not the MK2, and was excluded here.
- Given the number of inferred connector shapes, overall confidence is medium rather than high despite the manufacturer page being an unambiguous, authoritative source for feature/quantity claims.

ports.name: SDI In 1
ports.note: Dual auto-sensing 1080p HD/SDI inputs (60/59.94/50Hz); marketing copy says 'HD/SDI' but 1080p50/59.94/60 exceeds 1.5G HD-SDI bandwidth and requires 3G-SDI, so grade is inferred.

ports.name: SDI In 2
ports.note: See SDI In 1 — same auto-sensing pair; grade inferred.

ports.name: SDI Out (re-clocked)
ports.note: Re-clocked HD/SDI loop output per manufacturer copy; grade inferred to match inputs.

ports.name: Monitor Out (downconverted SDI/Composite)
ports.note: Switchable down-converted SD-SDI or composite (PAL/NTSC) output per manufacturer copy; not graded since exact SD-SDI level unstated and composite has no SDI grade.

ports.name: External Monitor Out
ports.note: MK2-specific external-display HD-SDI feed, sourced from a third-party operating handbook (not on the current manufacturer product page) — lower confidence this exact port persists as described.

ports.name: Analogue In 1 (Stereo)
ports.note: One of '2 Analogue Stereo Inputs' per manufacturer spec. Physical connector shape (discrete XLR3 vs multi-pin D-sub breakout) not explicitly confirmed by an accessible pinout diagram — inferred.

ports.name: Analogue In 2 (Stereo)
ports.note: Second stereo analogue input; same caveat as Analogue In 1.

ports.name: AES In (4 pairs / 8ch)
ports.note: '4 AES (4 Pairs/8 Channel) Inputs – 110Ω balanced or 75Ω unbalanced via optional CAB-D25-BNC cable' per manufacturer page. The breakout-cable requirement implies the base connector is a multi-pin D-sub (DB25) carrying multiple AES3 pairs, which is not in the allowed connector list — 'aes3' chosen as closest id.

ports.name: AES Out (4 pairs / 8ch)
ports.note: 'Fixed or variable AES multichannel outputs (4 pairs/8 channels)' per manufacturer page. Same D-sub-breakout caveat as AES In.

ports.name: Analogue Out (8 mono)
ports.note: 'Fixed or variable analogue multichannel outputs (8 mono)' per manufacturer page; connector shape inferred/uncertain (likely a multi-pin D-sub breakout rather than 8 discrete XLRs given 1U chassis depth).

ports.name: Headphone Out
ports.note: 'Headphone output with LS muting' listed as a feature; connector size/type not explicitly stated — standard 1/4in TRS assumed.

ports.name: GPI
ports.note: Manufacturer page confirms GPI-triggered presets ('5 hardware buttons, GPI, 24 internal'). A secondary TSL operating handbook (covering related PAM2 models) describes a 15-pin D-sub GPI connector, which is not in the allowed connector list — 'euroblock' used as a functional stand-in. Low confidence on exact connector shape.

ports.name: Remote Control (RS422)
ports.note: 'Serial remote control' listed as a manufacturer feature; RS422/D-sub detail drawn from a secondary TSL handbook covering related PAM2 models, not confirmed specifically for MK2.

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: Reported in a secondary operating handbook as fitted to the rear panel but 'not active in the initial product release'. Not mentioned at all on the current manufacturer product page — low confidence this port is present/active on current production units.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: For system updates and preset save/recall, per manufacturer page. Port type (USB-A) assumed for a flash-drive-style utility port; not explicitly stated.

ports.name: DC In 1
ports.note: One of the manufacturer-stated 'Dual 12V DC inputs' (redundant power). Exact connector style (simple barrel vs locking multi-pin) not confirmed by an accessible source.

ports.name: DC In 2
ports.note: Second of the dual redundant 12V DC inputs; same caveat as DC In 1.
